name: Zoltán Kovács
bio:
Zoltán's journey into the world of IT began with a fascination for disassembling and reassembling computers during his teenage years in Budapest. His formal education in computer science solidified his foundation, but it was his volunteer work at a local amateur racing club that ignited his passion for motorsport. He quickly realized that his IT skills could significantly contribute to a racing team's performance, moving from basic data analysis to developing custom software solutions for telemetry and race strategy.

Zoltán thrives on optimizing systems for peak performance, constantly seeking innovative ways to leverage technology to give Racing Start Academy a competitive edge. He believes in a proactive approach, anticipating potential problems before they arise and implementing robust security measures to protect sensitive data. His dedication extends beyond simply maintaining the IT infrastructure; he actively collaborates with engineers and strategists to develop cutting-edge tools that enhance their decision-making process. 

What sets Zoltán apart is his ability to translate complex technical concepts into easily understandable terms for non-technical staff. He fosters a collaborative environment where everyone feels comfortable sharing ideas and contributing to the team's overall success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed to the side with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Zoltán has a focused gaze and a lean build, often seen with a slight smirk.

quirks: Always carries a small USB drive filled with diagnostic tools.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on his desk when deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of strong, black coffee throughout the day.
